test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
estimated_root_cause: Coupon shows success and 10% OFF, but cart total stays at ¥418 instead of applying the discounted total ¥380.
recommended_action: Fix coupon total recalculation/rendering so the discount line updates the final total consistently.

test_case: カートページ › 複数商品をカートに追加してバッジが正しい
estimated_root_cause: After adding multiple items, cart badge count is 2 instead of expected 3, suggesting one add-to-cart action was dropped or rolled back.
recommended_action: Investigate cart state updates for consecutive adds and ensure badge count reflects all successful additions.

test_case: チェックアウトページ › 配送先フォームの全フィールドが表示される
estimated_root_cause: Test assumes a '.form-row' 2-column layout element exists, but the selector no longer matches even though field-specific checks are the real requirement.
recommended_action: Remove the layout-specific '.form-row' assertion and assert the actual input fields or stable form container instead.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › ステータスが「preparing」に進む
estimated_root_cause: Status progression is timing-dependent; the test checks too early and sometimes still sees 'received' before async transition to 'preparing'.
recommended_action: Poll/wait for status transition with a longer timeout instead of asserting a fixed-time snapshot.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › 最終的にステータスが「completed」になる
estimated_root_cause: Checkout page does not expose '#customer-name' during order setup, blocking order placement and downstream status checks.
recommended_action: Fix checkout form rendering/navigation so customer fields are present before order submission.

test_case: 注文履歴ページ › 注文履歴からステータスページに遷移できる
estimated_root_cause: Checkout page fails to render '#customer-name' during quick order creation, so the test cannot create the prerequisite order.
recommended_action: Fix checkout page/form availability so orders can be created before history-to-status navigation is exercised.

test_case: レート制限テスト › 通常のページ遷移でエラーが出ない
estimated_root_cause: Selector 'h1, .product-card' matches many elements and violates Playwright strict mode; this is a bad assertion, not an app failure.
recommended_action: Use a single stable locator or assert count/any-visible explicitly, e.g. first() or a page-specific heading.
